## Background

I'm a Strategic Management student at BYU with a minor in Philosophy. My journey has taken me from building fences on a Utah ranch to leading intern teams at tech startups. Along the way, I've developed a passion for solving problems at the intersection of strategy, technology, and human behavior.

I'm fluent in Spanish after spending two years as a volunteer representative in Houston, Texas, where I learned to connect with people from diverse backgrounds and communicate complex ideas simply.

## What's Next

I'm pursuing opportunities in consulting, particularly in win-loss analysis and strategic advisory. My long-term goal is to join or start a venture-backed company where I can combine my strategic thinking with my passion for building products that solve real problems.
